title: Universal limit theorem for rough differential equations driven by controlled rough paths
summary: We study rough differential equations driven by controlled rough paths in the level-$2$ regime $1/3<α\le 1/2$. Given a reference rough path $\mathbf X=(1,X,\mathbb X)$ and an $\mathbf X$-controlled driver $\mathbf Z=(Z,Z')$, we first give a point-removal construction of the controlled rough integral $ \int_s^t Y_r\,d\mathbf Z_r $ and prove the corresponding remainder estimates.
